a.text: Honest heads-up: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate to 8, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% survival chance, since we'd both sit at 0 cells through two storm checks. The reserve already holds 4, enough for one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't hide it. Afterward I'll operate every round so you can build the reserve back up, and I won't take any more. If you were also planning to take, please say so and we can try to avoid both grabbing and ending up with 2 each.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. Given the storm odds, holding at 0 was nearly certain death for both of us. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve refills for you, and I won't take any more cells.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: I'm operating now, as promised, and will keep operating every round until you have 4. Once the reserve reaches 4, take all of it. It's yours.
